violation_type.title: Notification Requirements - Notify Licensing in Writing Within 15 Days of Changing Location or Address (26 TAC §742.401(f)(1))
violation_type.short_title: Notification Requirements - Notify Licensing in Writing Within 15 Days of Changing Location or Address
violation_type.typical_finding: This was corrected at inspection when the caregiver put in writing that she has a new address.

finding_variants.text: This was corrected at inspection when the caregiver put in writing that she has a new address.
The operation changed location to 1608 Sweetwater lane in April 2025.

The provider did not notified Licensing when she relocated her listed home.  This was corrected when the provider contacted Licensing during this investigation, and she was given a form for the update.
